messages:
jamie_sales: Kickoff for NOVA Health POC. Need to align success criteria, data/security requirements, and timeline. High level asks from customer: clinical note summarization use case, PHI handling, target latency p95 < 300ms, quality threshold they want ~very high. Can team confirm feasible metrics and a 3-week plan?

alex_solutions: I propose 3-week plan — week 1: sample ingest + eval set creation; week 2: tuning/quant and performance tests; week 3: readout + handoff. Suggested success metrics: quality pass rate >= 85% on a 200-item eval set (relevance or custom rubric), p95 latency < 300ms, and cost target <= $0.015/token (we can model). Thoughts?

zach_eng: Technical notes: with Dedicated (2xA10G-ish) and batching=auto we should hit ~220ms p95 for 1k-token workflows. We'll enable KV caching. For PHI, Private/VPC is recommended to meet retention/KMS reqs. Need sample size and token distribution from customer by EOD Friday.

maria_ps: Security checklist — they need DPA + SOC2 report review, and for PHI we require either Private deployment or explicit contract terms with data-at-rest encryption + KMS/HSM. I'll send the standard security questionnaire template. @jamie_sales ask them to highlight regulator constraints (HIPAA scopes).

jamie_sales: Pricing question from the buyer: they expect a committed 6-mo contract. What's a ballpark for their expected baseline (200M tokens/month)? 

nick_finance: Back-of-envelope: reserved capacity for that volume (including 99th percentile overhead) lands around $XXk/mo. I'll prepare a committed quote and margin assumptions and DM the exact numbers.

alex_solutions: Eval harness: please ask NOVA to provide 200 annotated clinical notes + 50 edge-case notes. Proposed eval format:
`````
input: <clinical_note>
expected: <target_summary>
pass_if: similarity >= 0.80 OR score_on_rubric >= 4/5
`````
We can run batch evals and produce precision/recall-like metrics and qualitative failure buckets.

zach_eng: Ops details: default retention is 30 days; for enterprise set to 0 (no retention) in Private. We'll also enable audit logs and trace IDs. For keys they require HSM — we support KMS + HSM-backed options, maria can confirm.

jamie_sales: Action items:
1) NOVA to share sample dataset + token histogram by Thu EOD
2) Maria to send security questionnaire and DPA template
3) Alex to draft eval harness and readout template
4) Zach to provision dev/dedicated cluster (est. 24-48h after sample)
5) Nick to prepare committed pricing draft
Who will own the readout deck? 

alex_solutions: I'll own the deck + initial metrics. Please include sections: executive summary, metrics (quality pass rate, p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens), failure modes, next steps/expansion plan.

calendar-bot: Scheduled POC readout on 2026-03-26 16:00 UTC — invites sent to participants.

maria_ps: Quick security note: they flagged HSM requirement and need an export control questionnaire filled. I've uploaded the checklist to the shared folder (see internal link). 

jamie_sales: Thanks all — I'll nudge the customer for samples and set expectations. :thumbsup:
